svg.title: AI business assistant: the harbour shop
svg.desc: A small harbour with a dock, a shop with a striped awning and a sign reading AI ASSISTANT, a lamppost and a stopwatch on a pedestal. A boat arrives with a speech bubble: a customer message. In the shop window two shelves light up in parallel, meaning and spelling, and their results merge on the counter: hybrid search. A reply bubble flies back to the boat. The stopwatch arc shrinks from 20 minutes to under 30 seconds. Two more boats with lanterns bob at the dock: separate conversations kept apart.
